verdict: READY TO MERGE - 5 of 5 findings resolved, 0 bubbled
strengths: messenger.md model: sonnet now matches all four forking skills that dispatch it (branch-commit-msg, c-msg, merge-commit-msg, pr-sum all declare model: sonnet), removing a haiku/sonnet disagreement; the existing skill contract tests already pin sonnet for that fork.
The model changes are tight: one frontmatter line each in messenger.md, pr-fixer.md and pr-reviewer.md, with no stray edits to agent bodies or tools.
SKILL.md table edits are content-neutral: git diff -w reduces to the three separator rows and the escaped pipes in the capture and fold rows are intact.
pr-reviewer.md frontmatter still parses as YAML with name, description, model and tools present; blank lines inside the | block scalar are harmless.
Removing the stray closing fence in roast-my-code.md stops the mandatory-section rules and the Example input (lines 102-114) from rendering as a code block.

Scripted pr-review runs are unaffected: capture and waves rows always carry an explicit model, and no test pins the old frontmatter defaults (tests/scripts/test_pr_review_driver.py:821 pins the waves row model, produced by review_merge.py, which this PR leaves alone).

important.name: pr-fixer.md description still states the old default model (haiku)
important.summary: The description still says 'The default model is haiku; the dispatcher passes the model each wave row names.' while the frontmatter now sets model: sonnet. The PR changed the default but left the file's own statement of it wrong, and the description is the text a dispatcher reads when picking the agent. Waves rows print only haiku or opus (review_merge.py:634), so the sonnet fallback never matches a row.
fix: Change line 8 to: 'The frontmatter model (sonnet) is only a fallback; the dispatcher passes the model each wave row names (haiku for all-mechanical waves, else opus).'
Or drop the default-model clause entirely so the frontmatter is the single source.

important.name: Harness plugin version not bumped for changed agent defaults
important.summary: Three agent defaults changed (haiku/opus -> sonnet) plus a skill edit under plugins/harness/, but version is still 0.32.0 and the diff does not touch plugin.json. The project CLAUDE.md Releases rule requires a bump in the changed plugin's plugin.json, and recent harness changes on main bump it. Marketplace installs key updates on version, so consumers keep the cached 0.32.0 agents after merge.
fix: Bump version in plugins/harness/.claude-plugin/plugin.json to 0.32.1 (or 0.33.0 if model-default changes count as behavior changes).

minor.name: pr-reviewer.md description: dropped clause, vague model sentence, trailing whitespace
minor.summary: The rewrite cut 'skips the tool schemas review never uses' down to 'skips the tool schemas.', which now claims the agent skips tool schemas wholesale while it carries four tools. Line 8 'Model may be overridden, as-needed.' omits the contract: capture picks opus for every slot except one-file bucket slots (review_plan.py:352-381; pr-review SKILL.md:191 'opus by default'). Before this PR the frontmatter fallback (opus) matched that default; now a dispatch that drops the row's model silently gets sonnet for overall, roast, system_shape and lens slots. Lines 6, 7, 9 and 10 also carry trailing whitespace that ends up inside the description string (YAML still parses). The same fallback gap exists for pr-fixer (see I1).
fix: Restore 'so a run skips the tool schemas review never uses.' and strip trailing spaces on lines 6, 7, 9 and 10.
Replace line 8 with: 'The dispatcher passes each row's model (opus by default, sonnet for a one-file bucket slot); the frontmatter model is only a fallback.' Mirror the wording in pr-fixer.md (I1).

minor.name: roast-my-code.md Output Format template fence still broken; unrelated placeholder edits
minor.summary: Deleting the old closing fence fixed the stray fence that swallowed lines 102-114, but the Output Format template still breaks: the outer triple-backtick fence at line 79 is closed by the inner bare fence at line 92, so 'Credit' and 'Top Fix' render as real headings and the raw text has no template-end boundary before the rules at line 102. The '<...>' to '< ... >' change at lines 96 and 100 works around GitHub reading the placeholder as an HTML tag but leaves those placeholders spelled differently from the others (80, 85-91). The edit is unrelated to agent models and sits in a commit titled 'Align table formatting'. No script or test parses these placeholders.
fix: Open the template with a four-backtick fence at line 79 and add a matching four-backtick close after line 100; revert lines 96 and 100 to '<one sentence - what is genuinely good>' and '<the single most important change>'.
Or drop these roast-my-code.md edits from this PR.

minor.name: SKILL.md table re-padding inflates the skill by 14% with no content change
minor.summary: git diff -w shows only the three separator rows change, but the file grows from 71,431 to 81,500 bytes (+10,069, +14%), all spaces and dashes. The 'fold' row's ~700-char cell pads every row of the subcommand table to ~800 chars. The skill body loads into the main session on every pr-review run, and any later single-cell edit re-pads every row, hiding the real change in a 27-line diff. Unrelated to the agent-model intent.
fix: Restore the compact three-dash separator form for the subcommand table (lines 30-41); keep alignment only for the narrow bucket and lens tables, or revert all three for consistency.
Or revert commit c92d72e and move table alignment to a separate formatting PR.
